Name: Bazooka Mod
Author: CarlMontAmida
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds a Rocket Launcher for the 1.5.6 Stardew Valley Android.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Android 11-14 no Root or Android Go Edition Guide:[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Open Zarchiver[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Goto Downloads[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Copy BazookaMod.zip[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]paste BazookaMod.zip to[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]android/data/ZaneYork.SmapiStardewValley/files/mods.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]✅✅✅[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Explosive Ammo - An Ammo for Rocket Launcher.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Explosive Kills - When you kill slimes or ghosts or mummys or every enemies. Bullet Goes Exploding[/color]
